entries.summary: A full progression path for solo Normal play with automation, tuned to remain competitive with the pack's endgame gear at comparable effort.
compatibility_notes: The complete balance audit targeted FTB Evolution 2 1.5.1 and its original mod list. Later pack versions, other loaders and other Minecraft versions are not validated by this download.
All 90 Skills, 41 Bonuses, 6,981 payout ceilings and 11 bulk-material limits were checked in the generated result. A full progression and boss playthrough is still in progress.
The separate companion datapack is required. Install it with the four TOML files before rebuilding balance.

The original 1.5.1 pack uses FTB Teams 26.1.2.4 and FTB Library 26.1.2.9, which work with published Essence Ascendance beta.15. Updated packs with newer FTB versions need an Essence Ascendance build containing the subsequent compatibility fix; these configs cannot patch a mod jar.

entries.summary: A full progression path for solo Normal play with automation, intended to compete with ATM11's endgame equipment through stronger later investment.
compatibility_notes: The audit targeted ATM11 0.14.0-beta, its 298 original mod jars, and supplied and generated configurations. Later pack versions, other loaders and other Minecraft versions require another review.

All 90 Skills, 41 Bonuses, 66 equipment values, payout limits for 6,934 resources, 12 bulk-material entries and 124 equipment-reference corrections were checked in the generated result. Native rebuild and saved-profile validation passed; a full progression and boss playthrough remains unverified.
Install both the config and kubegroovy folders into the game directory. The required companion tag depends on ATM11's KubeGroovy server data loader.

Named ATM ore tool gates are retained. The Vigor Bow comparison assumes 40 installed heart canisters, and Essence casters retain lower raw damage because they bypass ordinary armor and damage cooldowns.
Use Essence Ascendance beta.17 or later; beta.17 fixes an equipment-rule refresh race that could prevent reopening a world in the same client session.
